protocol.sampling: 10 rounded linspace positions among sorted paired frame IDs per acquisition
protocol.fov: largest 4-connected component of working image >5; fill holes
protocol.roi: FOV pixels with Euclidean distance >16 working pixels from outside FOV or image
protocol.raw_potential: working intensity; outside FOV replaced by 255
protocol.local_contrast: max(Gaussian(sigma=8,reflect)-image,0); outside FOV filled with FOV median before Gaussian; scale=max(ROI 99.5th percentile,1); rint(255*clip(contrast/scale,0,1)); outside FOV score=0
protocol.local_potential: 255 minus the same quantized local contrast used by the direct baseline
protocol.selection: finite positive scores; ceil(budget*ROI pixels); retain entire cutoff tie block
protocol.development_objective: maximum acquisition-macro centerline coverage at nominal 1%; ties: lower actual area, then configuration insertion order
protocol.aggregation: mean of views within acquisition, then equally weighted acquisitions
protocol.timing_scope: observed pipeline wall times under concurrent workers; not controlled speed measurements
